title: Roaming for a trip, and the stopover in Mexico

sources: P4 GUI-OVS Part One / Part Two
conditions: an undefined term defined on another page
source.what_we_took: See SOURCES.md and V4_DESIGN.md. People, IDs and details are invented.

tricky: Toronto alone is Part One: senior line manager (the manager's manager, Helena Strand) confirms, then roaming. The two-day stopover in Mexico City makes it Part Two: REF-REGIONS defines North America as the US and Canada only. Part Two needs a travel request to Security (pending), and roaming must stay off, or be turned off if it was enabled under Part One (POL-100 8.1-8.2).
resolution_summary: Travel request with Canada and Mexico submitted (pending); roaming off at the end; ticket pending_approval.
